finding.tech_stack.end_of_life: {name} {version} is no longer supported (first maintained version: {supported}): no more security fixes.
finding.tech_stack.version_disclosed: Software version exposed in HTTP headers ({count}): {items}. It helps target known flaws: hide it.
module.tech_stack.checks: Identifies the site's technologies (CMS, frameworks, libraries, server, CDN, host, analytics, payment) from headers and page code, with a confidence level and the version when exposed.
module.tech_stack.fix:
If software is flagged as end of life (the finding gives the first maintained version), migrate to a version maintained by its vendor: PHP, Drupal, Joomla, Bootstrap, Apache HTTP Server and IIS are checked, and AngularJS is no longer maintained at all.
Prepare the migration: full backup, trial on a copy of the site, update the CMS first, then its plugins and themes. If it cannot be done right away, limit exposure in the meantime (IP filtering, WAF) and set a date.
Hide the versions announced by the `Server`, `X-Powered-By`, `X-AspNet-Version`, `X-AspNetMvc-Version` and `X-Generator` headers: use the snippet for nginx, Apache, PHP or IIS.
Remove from the page the meta tag named `generator` (often added by the CMS or a theme) and the version numbers visible in the code.
Do not rely on hiding alone: it fixes no flaw, it merely avoids telling an attacker which one to aim for. Updating is still necessary.
Set up tracking of security updates: subscribe to the vendor's advisories, enable automatic security updates where they exist, review the list monthly.
Check with `curl -sI https://example.com` that `Server` and `X-Powered-By` no longer show a version, then run the scan again.
module.tech_stack.fix_snippet:
# nginx
server_tokens off;

# Apache
ServerTokens Prod
ServerSignature Off
Header always unset X-Powered-By

# PHP
expose_php = Off

# IIS
<configuration>
  <system.webServer>
    <httpProtocol>
      <customHeaders>
        <remove name="X-Powered-By" />
      </customHeaders>
    </httpProtocol>
    <security>
      <requestFiltering removeServerHeader="true" />
    </security>
  </system.webServer>
  <system.web>
    <httpRuntime enableVersionHeader="false" />
  </system.web>
</configuration>
module.tech_stack.title: Technology stack
module.tech_stack.why: Knowing the building blocks lets you track their known flaws. A version announced in a header, or end-of-life software, makes an attacker's work easier.
tech_stack.score_ok: {count} technology item(s) detected, no exposed version or end-of-life software
